title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
why_useful: You already build on GitHub (this city lives there). Verified students get a bundle of free developer tools, and the pack page lists GitHub Copilot among them. Done: the owner already has it, so nothing is left to do.

title: Paul's Online Math Notes: Calculus I
why_useful: Free Calc I notes (limits, derivatives, applications) with practice problems that include full solutions, so you can self-test before quizzes and check each step.

title: Python Tutor
why_useful: Paste intro to CS code and watch it run step by step: variables, lists, and function calls drawn as you go. Great for debugging and for understanding code-tracing questions.
